Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 28: the slip of [[Maneuver Check (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on table. Starships may not move the turn they are deployed (or carried) to Death Star. Once per game, if Alderaan 'blown away,' may target a system. Unless opponent has a capital (or [Episode I]) starship there, Objectives treat target as a Subjugated planet. [Immune to Alter]”), word for word the text of [[Maneuver Check (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

Source SHA-256: <code>c63bf528513446184251b17042bb3992227dc4906436348ed7fe1c38b9df3840</code>. Crop rectangle in PDF points: <code>[402, 572, 586, 660]</code>, rendered at 200 dpi (11 November 2026, batch R8-B1).
